title: Split and cube minus probabilities agree
statement: Let $m\ge 0$ and $p\in[0,1]$. The probability that the split composed majority of independent biased signs (each sign is $+1$ with probability $p$ and $-1$ with probability $1-p$) equals $-1$ is equal to the probability that the composed majority on the full sign cube equals $-1$ under the same independent biased-sign law.
